name: theme-preview
title: Theme preview
description: A product screen inside a frame with its own theme, and a switch between light, dark and high contrast, so theming is something visitors can see.

docs: Pass title and, optionally, description, themes, defaultTheme and children. The frame carries data-theme, redefines the semantic tokens on itself (background, foreground, card, border, ring and the rest) and sets color-scheme, so everything in it follows while the page keeps its own theme. Only the semantic tokens (and [data-theme] selectors) follow the frame: a dark: variant in your own markup still follows the page's dark mode, so scope it to the frame with @custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *):not(.light *)); the frame carries a light or dark class for that. Light, dark and high contrast have colours built in; give a theme tokens (a map of custom properties) to show your own palette, and children to draw your own screen instead of the sample. The sample is made of RHS UI's own components, so hover, focus and press work in every theme. The switch is announced as "Showing the Dark theme"; theme and onThemeChange control it from outside.
